measurementRules.denominator: Per-game distinct normalized Unity-facing capability obligations from all authored gameplay/support C# plus minimal relevant scene/prefab/settings/package closure. C test-only obligations are in testRequirements and excluded from the gameplay denominator. This is not exhaustive API/type/overload/call-site counting.
measurementRules.normalization: Merge repeated uses of a declaration family or behavior within a game; split declarations from observable semantics and content/package obligations. Split materially different clone shapes and uncertain conversion/operator bindings. Do not add every participating type as another unit. Ordinary C# rules, .NET collections/LINQ, unused imports, template-only features and installed-but-unused packages are not separate gameplay obligations.
measurementRules.idRule: Frozen curated initial extraction A-R0001 etc.; append later discoveries without renumbering. C-R0028 through C-R0032 are separately scoped historical-test records, not gameplay. IDs were absent from the blocked pass.
measurementRules.referenceSyntax: source entries are game-relative-path:start-end, 1-based inclusive, combined with game.root. guide entries resolve IDs in guideEvidence to exact file/topic/lines. For absent rows guide citations identify nearby searched material, not positive evidence.
measurementRules.recordSemantics: contract identifies the type/member family or behavior; observation provides source evidence text/interpretation and unresolved details. Identity basis is imports, declared receiver types, inheritance and local source; no semantic compiler/reference-assembly binding. An exact overload or conversion not bound this way remains ambiguous.
measurementRules.aggregateRule: Ignore not-applicable dimensions. Any ambiguous => ambiguous; all covered => covered; all absent => absent; otherwise partial. Every row has at least one applicable dimension.
measurementRules.covered: Explicitly written bounded treatment at the stated family/behavior level, not correct/complete/exact-version certification. A family-level row does not claim every overload is declared.
measurementRules.absent: Not found after full G01-G18 plus stage4-supplement reading. Missing documentation is not a proven false Unity API claim.
measurementRules.counts: N=len(requirements)=covered+partial+absent+ambiguous; no partial weighting. Percent=100*count/N. totals are game-requirement instances, not a deduplicated cross-game union.
measurementRules.crossGameUnion: No union coverage figure claimed. Context-sensitive canonical key would include kind, resolved shape, behavior conditions and editor/package/pipeline context. Do not merge unresolved bindings or historical/modern aliases speculatively.
